tooling_notes: github_2__get_file_contents returns only the blob SHA (no body) in this environment and raw.githubusercontent is not fetchable (private repo). Read file bodies via get_commit(detail=full_patch) of the commit that added the file (+ later patches), or via PR get_files patches. Commits with >100 files need get_commit page=N. Renames show no previous_filename: list the parent tree to find the old path (WorkspaceProfile.js was agent/lib/project.js before 184cb712). Verify reconstructions with git blob sha1('blob <len>\0'+content). The P0 workflow on fix branches has a 'full' job (copy from fix/p0-1 96e712b) that reports every npm-test file's pass/fail + failing output in the p0-report comment, use it as the log source for structured-ai CI failures. Baseline (PR #22, main 9304338): structured-ai Node 18 fails, Node 20 passes; semantic-engine 20/22 pass. runtime.test.js on main (test/runtime/runtime.test.js) was renamed from test/runtime.test.js (init c7612ac9, 4129 lines, patch omitted by API): its full text is NOT reconstructable; rely on the full-suite report output. Settings: new runtime values must be SettingsSchema definitions read via require('../config').get(); no process.env reads or UPPER_CASE literal constants in agent/ code. Reconstructed files need a trailing newline appended to match the blob sha (apply_patch drops it). ArgParser.js (93ad8b6b) and Cli.js (93ad8b6b+9411b5be+184cb712+PR#23) reconstruct exactly. get_commit file lists are paged at 30 per page by default: pass page=N, perPage=100 until fewer than 100 come back. A merge commit patch is against its first parent: when list_commits has both the merge and a branch commit touching a file, apply only the merge (McpManager.js). Files that cannot be reconstructed (policy.json, runtime.test.js) can be dumped by the report job: the P0 workflow on fix/p0-2 checks out the repo in the report job and posts a "source excerpts" section; edit its file list as needed.
